$comment: Baseline of connectors KNOWN to be gapped on AGENTS.md security invariant #6 (they return external/attacker-controllable text without an <untrusted-content> envelope). Discovered by the Phase-2 sweep in docs/plans/260611_fox3490-untrusted-envelopes/ (FOX-3490). The check-untrusted-coverage.mjs gate lets these PASS so it does not go red across the repo on day one, while FAILING any NEW network-touching connector that is neither enveloped nor explicitly exempt. RATCHET: this list can only shrink. 2026-08-05: the FOX-3490 remediation wave completed — every formerly gapped connector now envelopes its external text, and the exemptions whose rationale had gone stale (google-analytics, gamma, runway, nano-banana, opus-video-clip, humaans) were remediated and removed. gappedConnectors is intentionally EMPTY; keep it that way.

exemptConnectors.openai-image: Generation connector — returns only IDs/status/asset URLs or binary image data.

exemptNote: exemptConnectors are connectors that trip the static network heuristic (they call fetch) but were reviewed and confirmed to return NO model-visible external/attacker-controllable text. This is the in-repo equivalent of a per-file `// untrusted-content-exempt:` marker, used because editing each connector's own source was out of scope for the FOX-3490 prevention-machinery change. If such a connector later starts returning external text, move it to gappedConnectors (or envelope it).
